BackstoryDef.title: unlicensed pharmacist
BackstoryDef.description: During their descent into the grey planet, [PAWN_nameDef] encountered a mini-barrel full of fentanyl and decided for some reason to chug it. \nHaving somehow survived the experience, [PAWN_pronoun] used this knowledge to dillute opioids for an unchipped settlement.

BackstoryDef.title: elder thornback slayer
BackstoryDef.description: For one overgrown depths colony, [PAWN_nameDef] was the one everyone relied on to protect the colony from the native Elder Thornbacks.

BackstoryDef.title: traumatized survivor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s time spent on the grey planet has left them mentally scarred. While [PAWN_pronoun] has gained various survival skills, [PAWN_pronoun] will collapse when under pain.

BackstoryDef.title: subsurface vulture
BackstoryDef.description: Plunged into the dried desert, food that wouldn't kill [PAWN_objective] was difficult to find. What was plentiful, however, were the bodies of the sawians that came before [PAWN_possessive]. \nIn desperation, [PAWN_nameDef] resorted to consuming the corpses that littered the land... and didn't stop when given normal food.

BackstoryDef.title: gravel dweller
BackstoryDef.description: After escaping with the others to the Rim, [PAWN_nameDef] realized something. After years of torment by scientists on the surface, [PAWN_pronoun] liked it in the caves. For the first time in [PAWN_possessive] life, [PAWN_pronoun] was right where [PAWN_pronoun] was supposed to be.

BackstoryDef.title: haunted survivor
BackstoryDef.description: Despite being stuck in the same situation, not all sawians were open to cooperation. [PAWN_nameDef] found out the hard way when a conversation with a Trader went out. \n[PAWN_nameDef] came out on top, but [PAWN_pronoun] will never be able to forget the screams of the Trader.

BackstoryDef.title: pyro landscaper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s life changed when [PAWN_pronoun] discovered fire. \n\n\PLEASE FINISH THIS!!!!

BackstoryDef.title: colony unchipper
BackstoryDef.description: Being chipped is a death sentence for anyone who chooses to abandoned the cargo mission. Fortunately, [PAWN_nameDef] was brave and skilled enough to attempt to remove the brain chips. \nWhile not every operation was successful, [PAWN_nameDef]'s resolve and determination to save as many as [PAWN_pronoun] could.

BackstoryDef.title: colony leader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a leader of a colony involved in the 'Interplanetary Escape Project'. Managing the needs of the colony and ensuring the project remains on track while neccesary has taken its toll on [PAWN_possessive] psyche.

BackstoryDef.title: colony courier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a courier who swiftly traversed from colony to colony. Carrying critical medical supplies and plans for the 'Interplanetary Escape Project' has given [PAWN_nameDef] unparalleled agility, but at the cost of [PAWN_pronoun] physical toughness.
